Name: TheDefective1's East Scarp NPC Portraits
Author: TheDefective1
Description:
I previously posted these NPCs individually, but I figured I'd post them all as a set now too since I think I'm done with this side project for the time being!

[b]To use these portraits, just drag the .PNGs for the portraits out of the .zip file and into the portraits folder within the Portraiture mod folder. [If you're in the right spot, the file location should look like this: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\mods\Portraiture\Portraits] [/b]

[b]Once you're in game, go talk to each of these NPCs and press 'P' while their dialogue is open until you see their portrait switch to mine! Then press 'O' to lock them onto that set of portraits, so that you can still change other NPCs portraits without resetting these ones.[/b]

I've been working on portraits for characters from East Scarp that aren't included in a lot of portrait mods that are out so far, but I think I'll stop with these ones for now! I've pretty much done all the ones that I liked the most (who didn't already have many portrait options) but feel free to let me know if there are other NPCs you might want me to try in the future! I may get around to more someday when I have less projects to work on... :)
